vaulting.description: Players can now vault directly through building window frames

air_surfing.description: Allows players to deploy and skate using a surfboard while freefalling in the air

view_distance.impact: Players can render and spot enemy entities at significantly longer combat distances

right_hand_cover_exploit_fix.bug_fixed: Fixed an issue where right-handed character camera angles allowed shooting enemies safely behind cover without exposure

reconnect_system.description: Disconnected players are now allowed to rejoin active live matches
